patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff does not apply cleanly to the c7131407 vulnerable checkout left by Stage 01, so fixed-side validation uses the real source-level guard from the prebuilt 18066-fix image instrumented at the same source sites. That fixed source contains the expected `if (L == 0) return {};` guard in `permutateAlt()` and the original PoC runs clean there.

nodes.description: At `if (state[n] == 0)`, the index `n` still lies outside the `state` allocation length `L` (`n >= L`), so the sink reads past a zero-length array.

edges.description: The same local `L` computed from `in.size()` at entry is reused unchanged at the sink.
The underflowed index `n = in.size() - 1` is carried unchanged to the later `state[n]` sink.
The empty `vars` vector materialized by `resolve_parent_refs()` is passed unchanged into `permutateAlt()` and becomes the local length `L`.

root_cause_criterion.description: Before `n = in.size() - 1` and `new size_t[L]`, a correct program must enforce `L > 0` so `permutateAlt()` does not underflow the state index or allocate a zero-length `state` array.
